feature_scope: RFM and customer activity summary from customer-sales candidates only.
revenue_interpretation: Net spend in GBP (purchases minus cancellations/returns, Quantity x UnitPrice); gross spend is a separate column; not profit and not CLV.

definitions.recency_days: Days from last purchase date to one day after the latest candidate invoice date.
definitions.frequency_orders: Distinct non-cancellation InvoiceNo values per customer.
definitions.gross_spend_gbp: Sum of candidate purchase lines (Quantity x UnitPrice).
definitions.cancelled_spend_gbp: Value of the customer's valid cancelled/returned product lines.
definitions.net_spend_nonpositive: True when net spend is zero or negative; review before using in RFM.
definitions.customer_tenure_days: Calendar days between the customer's first and last candidate purchase dates.
